programs.title: Dil Ka Rishta
programs.desc: Jai unintentionally kills the husband of a woman that he loves. When she gets diagnosed with amnesia, Jai comforts her and she falls in love with him. Now, guilt-ridden Jai is left in a dilemma whether to confess his guilt or reciprocate her love.

programs.title: I Proud To Be An Indian
programs.desc: An Indian father-son duo goes to London for a family wedding. While in London the son, who is named I, finds out that his community is being threatened by white nationalists. Seeing this, he decides to stand up for his community and fight the racism.

programs.desc: Two warring kingdoms  Thambore and Araavali  decide to end their enmity by marrying their children. But post a fateful incidence the kingdoms revert to rivalry. Now Araavali prince's love for Thambore's princess is their only hope to end the rivalry.
